lemma: Convention-fixed definition of P (gap (a)). Let F_N: {0,1}^N -> {0,1} be the MCSP function on N input bits (N = truth-table length, CJW20 Def. 2.1). Define P_beta,eps(F) := [L(F_N) >= N^(2+beta-eps)] for the family F = (F_N). P is a property of the whole function family, not of a single truth table: per-table versions are refuted by Lupanov (every m-variable table has a De Morgan formula of size O(2^m/m) = O(N/log N)). Mandatory control, computed by hand: L(parity_N) = Theta(N^2) (Khrapchenko, SOURCE). For beta <= eps, N^(2+beta-eps) <= N^2 <= L(parity_N), so P HOLDS for parity_N. The spec requirement 'P must fail for parity' is therefore NOT met by this P. Resolution: parity_N has CC = Theta(N) > N^beta for beta < 1, so parity_N is outside the MCSP[N^beta] range (its yes-status is false for this threshold). The control must be applied to yes-instances of MCSP[N^beta] only, i.e. P must be restricted to the range {F : CC(F) <= N^beta}. Consequence: the defining property of P is circuit-independent (formula leaves over N inputs), and CJW20 Thm 1.6 is exactly the statement that the MCSP function satisfies P_beta,eps for all beta in (0, alpha). Thus gap (a) reduces to the citation CJW20 Thm 1.6 (SOURCE, not a new proof). Gap (b) is then also SOURCE. The open content is lemma (c) and R-MCSP. No new proved lemma in this session.

proved_step: LEMMA (session R0791, CLAIMED, unreviewed): if a fan-in-2 AND/OR/NOT circuit with S gates has every non-output gate of fan-out at most 1 and every gate reachable from the output, then its function has a De Morgan formula with at most S+1 leaves; hence L <= 2S for S >= 1, i.e. R-MCSP with C=2, c=0 in the fan-out-1 case r=0. Proof: fan-out 1 makes the gate graph a tree rooted at the output; a tree with b binary gates has b+1 leaves; NOT gates add none; De Morgan pushes negations to literal leaves without changing the leaf count.
